standard.$description: Dialogs and the command palette as they open.

deliberate.$description: Slower reveals, such as the tag editor's expanding search.

shimmer.$description: One sweep of the loading placeholder shimmer.

standard.$description: The CSS ease curve, the Web transition default.

enter.$description: Ease out, for elements that appear. The native default.

exit.$description: Ease in, for elements that leave.

emphasized.$description: A quick start with a long settle, for sheets and reveals.

inOut.$description: Ease in and out, for looping and symmetric motion.

linear.$description: Constant speed, for progress and shimmer.
